query: query adjournConveneLegislativeDays($sessionAbbreviation: String, $where: LegislativeDayWhere! = {}, $search: String, $offset: Int, $limit: Int, $order: Order = ["calendarDate", "DESC"]) { legislativeDays(where: [{ sessionAbbreviation: { eq: $sessionAbbreviation } }, $where], search: $search, offset: $offset, limit: $limit, order: $order) { data { calendarDate sessionAbbreviation legislativeDay houseConveneTime houseAdjournTime senateConveneTime senateAdjournTime } count } }
